text.p: Following are the main stories in Friday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Second Industrial Master Plan will focus on continuing economic growth, enhancing exports and increasing the value of the goods produced and exported, Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said.

- UMNO president Mahathir Mohamad announced the appointment of eight new supreme council members and sprang a few surprises when Information Minister Mohamed Rahmat was dropped as secretary-general and replaced by Culture, Arts and Tourism Minister Sabbaruddin Chik.
- In an unprecedented move, the Securities Commission has revoked its approval for Fumakilla (M) Bhd's listing on the second board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.

- Mohd Nadzmi Mohd Salleh, the former managing director of Proton, is to lead the privatization of state-owned Mara Holdings Sdn Bhd, Entrepreneur Development Minister Mustapa Mohamed confirmed yesterday.

- The Second Industrial Master Plan launched yesterday will see the manufacturing sector's contribution to the gross domestic product (GDP) reach 38.4 percent by the year 2005, an unchartered territory even for the most industrialised countries.
- Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad unveiled the Second Industrial Master Plan which is aimed at continued economic growth, development of cluster industries and quality-driven exports.
